lines.text: Sl. 34. बृहस्पति—from बृहत् speech + पति the lord of; here the
planet Jupiter, तद्बृहतोः करपत्योश्चोरदेवतयोः सुट् तलोपश्च Vârt. on
Pân. VI. I. 157. स् is substituted for the final of बृहत् and तत्
when followed by पति and कर when the sense is a particular
deity and a thief respectively; so तत् + कर = तस्कर. संभावितः—well
respected or esteemed i. e. of middle size.

transcription.note: The Sanskrit grammatical quotation is somewhat unclear.

lines.text: विशेष०—see com; or विशिष्यत इति विशेषः unusual, uncommon; or
शिष्यते इति शेषः। विगतः शेषः यस्य complete, hence uncommon; विशेष-
विक्रमः विशेष० तत्र रुचिः यस्य bent on performing deeds of unusual
valour. वैरायते A denom. from वैर meaning वैरं करोति; derived
with the aff. क्यङ्; see com. भास्वरो brilliant. भ्रान्तः—v. l. revol-
ving; कर्तरि क्तः by गत्यर्थाकर्मक-&c. Pan. III. 4, 72. पर्वन्—The
time of new or full moon ( opposition or conjunction ). शीर्षाव०—
The allusion here is to the severance of the demon’s head at the
time when the nectar that was churned out of the ocean was
served to the gods, and Râhu attempted to drink it by joining
their line. The sun and the moon informed Vishnu of the
fraud, whereupon he severed the demon’s head with his
discus. But as the demon had tasted a little quantity of
amrita the head lived and is supposed to wreak its vengeance
on the two luminaries. See Mat. Pu. Adh. II. 5. 13. 16. Bhâg.
P. VIII. 9. 23–26, The fig is अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा as the action of
Râhu which is not the matter in hand (अप्रस्तुत) implies the
action of an inveterate wicked man which is the matter intended
to be described.

transcription.note: Several Sanskrit words and the split compound at the beginning are not perfectly clear.

lines.text: Sl, 35. फणाफलक The flat surface of (extensive board for-
med by ) his hoods. Comp. Mat. Pu. CCLIX. 7. मध्येपृष्ठम्—on
the back. Avy. Comp. This is less common though by no
means very rare: comp. Bv. I. 60; Nai. III. 40; Sis III, 70
VII. 52 and 70 Bhatti V. 4. पारे मध्ये षष्ठ्या वा। Pân. II.
1. 18. The words पार and मध्य are optionally compounded
with a noun in the gen. case forming an Avy., the final अ of
these being irregularly (निपातनात् एदन्तत्वं चानयोर्निपात्यते। Sid.
Kau.) changed to ए; optionally there may be Gen. Tat. e. g.
